body.message:
No, I refuse to be charged for any services that I did not receive in my apartment, especially when your team provided me with incorrect information. I was told that the technician would return after one hour, after finishing the neighboring apartments, but he never came back.

It is your responsibility to provide an effective solution to the dust and cockroach issue that I have been experiencing since the very first day I moved into the property. I also expect you to arrange for your maintenance and pest control team to return at a time that is convenient for me, when I am at home, as I am a tenant of your property.

You already sent a pest control team once, but the treatment did not produce any effective results. It is your responsibility to ensure that this maintenance issue is properly resolved, as it is affecting my health and quality of living.

You cannot charge tenants for services that were never provided. I expect the charge to be removed immediately and for this issue to be resolved without any further inconvenience.
